payload.claim: The Context section's line citations into saffron/task.py and tests/test_task.py are stale relative to this snapshot, because SA-0421/SA-0422 (this spec's depends_on) edited task.py after the context was 'read at 344de2af'. E.g. 'The EXHAUSTED line ... is at saffron/task.py:1074-1084' actually points to the comment and push_unpackaged_work call, not the append_queue_line/queue_line construction (actually ~1092-1102); 'the line for a task PACKAGE never ran' cited at :1105-1115 is actually at ~1123-1133; 'the live rows already guard theirs with except Exception' cited at :957, :981 is actually at :966 and :994; 'except BaseException' cited at :1045 is actually at :1063; the EXHAUSTED-line-replacement comment cited at :1072-1073 is actually at :1090-1091; tests/test_task.py case 5 cited at :2563-2584 is actually at ~2698-2717 and its docstring sentence cited at :2407-2409 is actually at ~2538-2545; of the three direct _finish calls cited as tests/test_task.py:401, :5473, :5505, only :401 is correct (the other two are actually at :5608 and :5640). By contrast every citation into saffron/phases/package.py and saffron/ledger.py (barely touched by the dependency specs) checks out exactly. This does not block the build because the four numbered Problem steps are phrased functionally (by function/behavior, not raw line number) and are independently verifiable, but a less careful build could be misled trying to locate the exact code the Context describes at the cited lines.
